prompt:
This file is a prompt only. Invent the skill system on this machine with shell and edit. Skills follow https://agentskills.io/specification. One skill = one directory with SKILL.md. The header must be YAML frontmatter with name and description.

Install-scoped skills: <install>/agent-store/seed-agent/skills/<name>/SKILL.md
Workspace skills: $PWD/.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md

Register every readable skill into the Machine index system.skills as {name, description, path, ok, note}. ok true only if the directory is readable and contains SKILL.md. Do not copy SKILL.md bodies into the tree. Do not register the parent skills/ directory as a skill.

Create the two root directories if missing. You may add a tiny example under agent-store/seed-agent/skills/hello/ whose SKILL.md explains how to list skills. An example does not replace scanning $HOME/.claude/skills, $HOME/.codex/skills, $HOME/.agents/skills if those exist; copy or register what you find.

When the human later says /skills: list name+description+ok; install copies or writes a directory; enable/disable flips ok. Until commands.json is done, still write the directories and the tree.

Check before done:
1) both skill roots exist as directories
2) at least one SKILL.md is readable and starts with --- then a name: line
3) system.skills has a matching {name, path, ok:true} entry whose path is that skill directory, not the parent
If the check fails, leave ours.seed_agent.skills unset.
